messages:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout for release rwinf-1.4.0-rc3 -> 10% in eu-west, prebake warmup in progress. Change window: 2026-03-20T02:00Z-03:00Z. Release notes: https://redwood.s3/releases/rwinf-1.4.0-rc3.md :rocket:

alex: Hold — prebake drain still running on eu-west-3 (kv-cache eviction). Seeing background GC and pod restarts. Can we pause before percent shift? :eyes:

jamie: Pinging ops-sre — any objections to a temporary hold until drain completes? this is canary traffic only but better safe.

ops-sre: Saw a brief mem spike on node eu-west-3b 2m ago. Eviction count is non-zero but not yet stabilized. Recommend hold for 10m or until eviction count returns to 0.

deploy-bot: Manual hold requested by alex at 3189012390. Rolling percent to 0%. Canary instances pinned to rwinf-1.4.0-rc3@pinned-eu3.

mike-pm: Noted. Any customer-facing impact?

alex: No customer impact expected — canary was only 10% internal. Will post rollback plan if we need to revert.

sara: Quick sanity: logs show repeated k/v cache tombstones during eviction. If drain continues >15m we'll revert traffic back to rwinf-1.3.9 per rollback playbook.

jamie: Can someone run this quick snippet to confirm no sockets stuck: ```kubectl exec -n rwinf svc-eu3 -- ss -tuna | grep ESTAB || true```

ops-sre: Ran check — sockets clean. Pod restarts finishing. Eviction metric trending down (0.6 -> 0.1). Recommend ready in ~5m.

deploy-bot: Status update: prebake warmup still finishing (step 4/5). Holding percent shift. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

alex: OK — we'll keep pinned for now. jamie, can you hold the rollout and comment when ready? I'll update the release notes with the hold reason.

jamie: Holding. Will re-run health checks at +5m and +10m. If all green, propose moving to 10% then 25% over next 30m.

mike-pm: Thx. I'll notify support that rollout is paused and we have a plan.

deploy-bot: Action log: hold applied by jamie at 3189012460. Rollout state: PAUSED. Pin: rwinf-1.4.0-rc3@pinned-eu3. Next automated attempt canceled.

ops-sre: Final check at 3189012645 — eviction=0, pod-restarts=0 in last 5m, latency p50/p95 stable. Looks safe to resume when eng gives go.

alex: Go ahead and resume to 10% then watch. jamie — please call stop if any regressions.

jamie: Resuming now. rolling to 10% -> monitoring. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Rollout resumed by jamie at 3189012660. Current target: 10% (eu-west). Monitoring hooks active.
